source_title: Canelo vs. Mbilli Livestream: How to Watch the Boxing Fight Online In the U.S.
source_excerpt:

Boxing superstar Canelo Alvarez (63-3-2) is back in the ring this weekend for a chance to regain the WBC belt. In his way is undefeated titleholder Christian Mbilli (29-0-1). The blockbuster bout will be held inside Kingdom Arena in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, with a U.S. livestream available on DAZN .
At a Glance: How to Watch Canelo vs. Mbilli Fight
This will be Canelo’s first time fighting since losing his super middleweight titles to Terence Crawford last year, and a crucial bout if the 36-year-old wants to keep his boxing career alive. Mbilli is on a different trajectory. The 31-year-old Cameroonian fighter won the WBC interim super middleweight title with a knockout against Maciej Sulęcki in June, 2025, and a win against Alvarez would cement him as a bona fide star.
Read on for all the details on how to watch the Canelo vs. Mbilli fight here in the U.S.
Canelo vs. Mbilli Fight Date, Start Time, Location
The Canelo vs. Mbilli fight will take place on Saturday, Oct. 31, at Kingdom Arena in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. The fight livestream will start at 2 p.m. ET/11 a.m. PT with ring walks expected around 6 p.m. ET/3 p.m. PT.
Where to Stream Canelo vs. Mbilli Fight Online In the U.S.
The only way to watch the Canelo vs. Mbilli fight here in the U.S. is on DAZN Pay-Per-View .
To get the Canelo vs. Mbilli PPV, you’ll need a subscription to DAZN. If you don’t have one, you can get an eight-day free trial to the service’s monthly package and purchase the Canelo vs. Mbilli PPV for $79.99. The monthly plan will renew at $24.99 after the trial ends, but you can cancel anytime (do so within eight days, and you’ll only pay the $79.99 for the PPV). Another option is to sign up for the DAZN annual plan, which is billed monthly at $19.99, although this option doesn’t have a free trial.
A third option for fans looking to stream Canelo vs. Mbilli is to get DAZN Ultimate. This plan includes all PPV fights at no additional cost. DAZN Ultimate requires an annual contract and costs $49.99 per month or $449.99 if you pay for a whole year upfront. This plan gets you access to a minimum of 12 pay-per-view events a year, so it’s a good option if you plan on watching more fights throughout the year.
However you choose to sign up for DAZN, you’ll be able to stream the entire Canelo vs. Mbilli fight card today.
